description: On the bed in front of you are a pair of black glasses and a small cream-colored folding glasses case. The left hand slides forward toward the glasses while the right hand also reaches in; both hands lift the glasses as a two-hand object and briefly adjust their orientation, then the left hand pulls the open case closer as a left-hand object while the right hand guides the glasses down into the case as a right-hand object, before the right hand closes and secures the case.
